protocol.scope: SeDPO only, following documented settings; not reconstruction of the unknown original CoopES test IDs or scores
protocol.selection_rule: sha256([seed,task,role,official_id]) ascending, unique question content, first n; no performance-based choice
protocol.inference_scope: Exploratory paired comparison; these source test splits have previously been evaluated

evaluation.system: Answer with exactly one letter: A, B, C or D.
evaluation.allowed_tokens: exactly one canonical token for each bare A/B/C/D

selector_policy.candidate_source: official train only, same 50 original IDs for both methods
selector_policy.utility_or_tuning_queries: 50 official validation queries reserved; existing retrievers use their previously documented independent training-query dev split
selector_policy.implementation: Original SeDPO encoder and beam search, with data adapters; CoopES is not run or required
selector_policy.training_budget: record actual SeDPO preference-training data/checkpoint; no claim of equal offline training costs

protocol.comparison_policy: External descriptive reference only; no assertion of identical original samples/models/decoding, no paired test against published aggregates
protocol.revision_reason: The eager/fp16 run raised non-finite generation scores before a valid result; use the SDPA backend that passed the previous full evaluations. Dataset membership, candidate IDs, dtype, prompts and decoding are unchanged.

selector_manifest.description: Original DPR SeDPO beam search, restricted to the frozen 50 candidates; adapters only replace data loading; original-ID-based task templates
selector_manifest.training_budget_note: Retriever was trained with the previously recorded full-pool preference data; no equal offline-cost claim

comparison_scope: SeDPO only; published CoopES scores are external, unpaired references; original test IDs and decoding are unknown. No method-superiority proof or paired significance test.
